name: What-if (hypothetical, for the demo): five storeys inside the staff benchmark with every funder question answered
rezoning_path: CD-1 under the Interim Rezoning Policy for Social Housing
land_tenure_plan: 60-year lease at nominal rent from the church to the society, resolved by the church board (hypothetical: written for the demo, not an actual resolution)
notes: Hypothetical option written so that the funder questions all come back answered: the same five-storey massing as the other what-if, a 30/50/20 rent-tier split, 5 accessible units (5% of 88), a 60-year agreement, 19 replacement trees, and a land tenure stated as settled rather than 'to confirm', so the Community Housing Fund check can pass instead of waiting. None of these figures come from Catalyst or the City; the tenure resolution does not exist.
